title: Studio canvas selection strip names the selected widget by its English source label in a zh-CN session
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Found in the live run of PR #36420 (card #36373), finding 3. Out of that card's scope. Filed by the seat.

## What happens

In a zh-CN session, select the 「阶段管道分布」 widget (dataset widget of `sales_dashboard`, HotCRM) on Studio's dashboard design canvas. The canvas selection strip reads 「已选中：Pipeline by Stage」: the prefix is translated, the selected item's name is the English source. The strip reads `selection.label` in `StudioDesignSurface`, which carries the authored source label, not the served (current-language) one.

## What should happen

The strip names the selection in the session's language, the same text the panels beside it show (「已选中：阶段管道分布」), using the served label PR #36420 introduces for the panels (`servedLabel.ts`) rather than a second reading.

## Notes

- Same class as #36373 (panels show the served label), outside its panels.
- Check the other kinds the canvas can select (report, page section) in the same change.
